resources.string: Fluent builds one accent ramp from the primary palette. Secondary, tertiary, error and neutral colors never reach it, and its neutrals are fixed greys.
For Fluent, the style only changes the chroma of the accent ramp.
Fluent’s text colors are fixed and its ramps ignore contrast.
Contrast changes the slots that follow a role. Slots picked by tone keep their tones.
Pins set Material roles, which Fluent does not use.
The Unstyled adapter has no AMOLED switch yet.
Fluent has no place for extra accents yet.
Unstyled and Fluent need JVM 17 and have no macOS native target. Unstyled needs Android minSdk 23.
The 2025 Dim roles stay hidden until a library module exposes them.
